name: start_recording
title: Start Recording
description: Start a background screen recording. Returns a session id; finalize it with stop_recording. Never auto-starts.

target.description: full | monitor:<i> (0 = primary) | window:<title> (or window:exe=<app.exe> / window:hwnd=<n>) | region:<x>,<y>,<w>,<h>. With gdigrab a window's rectangle is resolved once at start (visible, on top); it does not follow the window.

exactTitle.description: window: targets match the whole title only, never a substring (default false).

source.description: system = what the machine plays (needs a loopback device); none = video only.

device.description: dshow loopback device (from list_audio_devices); auto-detected if omitted.

output.description: Output .mp4 path (default under SCREENCAST_HOME/recordings).

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

maxDurationSec.description: Auto-stop after this many seconds (default 3600 or SCREENCAST_MAX_RECORDING_SEC; max 7 days; 0 = no cap).

events.description: Also log clicks, scroll, cursor, and typing (video-timed, video pixels) for read_events (default false; ~1 s slower start).

keys.description: With events: masked (default) logs typing only as 0.5 s-grid bursts, never keys; shortcuts also names Ctrl/Alt/Win chords. Typed text is never logged.

cursor.description: events: leave the OS cursor out and log it (implies events) for the cursor tool to redraw.

backend.description: gdigrab (default): the screen rectangle. wgc (window: targets, FFmpeg 8+): the window's own surface, even when covered or moved; client area only, no audio. ddagrab: one display on the GPU, low CPU.

encoder.description: auto = first working GPU encoder, else x264 (default with ddagrab; else x264).

webcam.description: Also record a camera to <output>.webcam.mp4, aligned for overlay.

replayBufferSec.description: Instant replay: keep only the last N s (bounded disk) for save_replay. gdigrab only.

name: stop_recording
title: Stop Recording
description: Stop a recording gracefully so the file is finalized; returns the path and duration.

save.description: Replay buffer: write it all to outputPath first (default: discard).

name: pause_recording
title: Pause Recording
description: Pause a recording; until resume_recording nothing is captured, and the gap is left out of the file, events, and markers.

name: resume_recording
title: Resume Recording
description: Resume a paused recording (same target and settings).

name: save_replay
title: Save Replay
description: Save the last N seconds of a replay buffer (start_recording replayBufferSec) to an mp4; the buffer keeps running.

sessionId.description: Session id of a replay buffer.

lastSec.description: Seconds back from now (default and max: the buffer length).

output.description: Output .mp4 path (default under SCREENCAST_HOME/recordings).

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

reencode.description: Frame-exact re-encode. Default: instant stream copy that may hide up to 2 s of earlier frames.

name: list_sessions
title: List Sessions
description: List all recording sessions (active and finished) with their status, target, output path, and whether the process is still alive.

name: get_session
title: Get Session
description: Inspect a single recording session by id, including live status and whether its output file exists on disk.

name: read_events
title: Read Input Events
description: Read the input events (clicks, scroll, cursor, shortcuts, typing bursts) of a recording made with events: true, in video seconds and pixels; e.g. types: ['down'], then sample_frames there.

sessionId.description: Session id of a recording started with events: true.

input.description: Or a recording path, or its .events.jsonl.

types.description: down/up (mouse buttons; clicks are down), move (sampled cursor), wheel, key (shortcut), typing (burst), gap (events may be missing).

inFrameOnly.description: Drop events whose cursor was outside the recorded area.

name: add_marker
title: Add Marker
description: Mark a labelled moment on a recording, live or at a second. Kept in the session and a sidecar; chapters and pipeline turn markers into chapters.

sessionId.description: Recording to mark (a stopped one needs at).

name: review_recording
title: Review Recording
description: Open a recording for a person to review: in MCP Apps clients an inline player to scrub, trim, and redact, then export; elsewhere just the video's details.

sessionId.description: Or the session id of a stopped recording.

name: player_frames
title: Player Frames
description: Preview frames for the review player: JPEGs on an even grid over the video plus frames at scene changes, with their real times. Used by the inline player; agents should use sample_frames or contact_sheet instead.

maxFrames.description: Frames on the even grid (default 120); scene-change frames come on top, up to as many again.

name: screenshot
title: Take Screenshot
description: Capture one PNG of the screen, a monitor, a window, or a region, returned inline and by path.

target.description: full | monitor:<i> (0 = primary) | window:<title> (or window:exe=<app.exe> / window:hwnd=<n>) | region:<x>,<y>,<w>,<h>. Titles match exactly, else as a substring; topmost wins.

exactTitle.description: window: targets match the whole title only, never a substring (default false).

backend.description: gdigrab (default, ~0.2 s): what is visible. wgc (window:, FFmpeg 8+, ~1-2 s): the window even if covered.

output.description: Optional output .png path. Defaults to a file under SCREENCAST_HOME/screenshots.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

returnImage.description: Return the image inline (default true; the PNG on disk stays full size).

name: sample_frames
title: Sample Frames
description: Sample PNG frames from a video (by fps, timestamps, or scene changes) and return the first few inline so the model can see what happened.

input.description: Path to the source video file.

mode.description: scenes: only frames where the screen changed (strongest first), usually the cheapest review. Default: fps or timestamps, whichever is given.

timestamps.description: Seconds to grab a frame at (mode timestamps).

sceneThreshold.description: Mode scenes: change needed to count, 0-1 (default 0.1).

dedupe.description: Mode fps: drop near-duplicate frames (default false).

outputDir.description: Optional folder for the frames (a relative path resolves under SCREENCAST_HOME/frames). Defaults to SCREENCAST_HOME/frames/<id>.

maxFrames.description: Frame cap (default 100); fps is lowered to fit while still spanning the video.

returnImages.description: Return the first maxInlineImages frames inline (default true).

maxInlineImages.description: Frames to embed inline (default 8); all are listed by path.

name: contact_sheet
title: Contact Sheet
description: Tile timestamped frames of a video into one image to see a whole recording at a glance (the cheapest first look).

mode.description: even (default) or scenes (strongest changes; static stretches take no tiles).

poster.description: Write one representative poster frame instead of a sheet.

output.description: Optional output .png path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/frames.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: screen_diff
title: Screen Diff
description: Compare two screenshots or frames: SSIM score, changed share, and changed boxes in b's pixels, to check a UI change happened only where expected.

b.description: After image (or video); scaled to a's size.

pixelThreshold.description: Mean 0-255 difference for a ~32x32 cell to count as changed (default 12).

returnImage.description: Return b inline with changes outlined (default true).

name: wait_for_change
title: Wait for Screen Change
description: Wait until part of the screen changes or settles, instead of guessing a sleep. Returns the elapsed time, changed regions (screenshot pixels; add `origin` for desktop), and the final state.

target.description: What to watch: full | monitor:<i> | window:<title> (or exe=/hwnd=) | region:<x>,<y>,<w>,<h>.

exactTitle.description: window: targets match the whole title only (default false).

mode.description: change (default): return once it differs from the start. settle: once it has been still for settleSec.

timeoutSec.description: Give up after this many seconds (default 30; a timeout is a result, not an error).

pixelThreshold.description: Mean 0-255 difference for a ~32x32 cell to count as changed (default 12).

returnImage.description: Return the final state inline (default true).

keep.description: Keep the final screenshot on disk and return its path (default false).

name: find_text
title: Find Text (OCR)
description: OCR (built into Windows) on the screen, an image, or video frames, with line and match boxes in image pixels (add `origin` for desktop coordinates). Locate UI text or secrets (e.g. regex 'sk-|ghp_|api.?key') to redact. Best-effort: review results.

target.description: Live screen target (full | monitor:<i> | window:... | region:...), or pass input.

input.description: Image or video file to read instead of a live target.

scanEverySec.description: Video input: scan a frame every N s across the clip (e.g. for secrets before sharing); matches and redactRegions get times. Widens to stay within maxFrames.

exactTitle.description: window: targets match the whole title only (default false).

backend.description: Live target: gdigrab (default) = what is visible; wgc (window:, FFmpeg 8+) = the window even if covered.

query.description: Text to find (case-insensitive, tolerates OCR misreads like I/l, O/0, _/-). Omit to return all text.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression (case-insensitive).

redact.description: Also return padded match rectangles ready for redact_region's regions.

keep.description: Live target: keep the capture and return its path (default false: deleted after reading).

returnImage.description: Return the image with matches outlined (default: true with a query).

name: index_recording
title: Index Recording
description: Build a recording's text timeline (<video>.index.json: OCR per scene, events, markers, transcript) for search_recording.

transcript.description: An .srt, or 'whisper' to transcribe. Default: <video>.srt if any.

force.description: Re-OCR despite a matching cached index.

name: search_recording
title: Search Recording
description: Search an index_recording timeline (screen text, events, markers, transcript): timecoded hits, best first, secrets masked. No frames unless asked.

images.description: Thumbnails of the top N hits (default 0).

name: get_media_info
title: Get Media Info
description: Probe a media file with ffprobe and return duration, resolution, frame rate, codecs, container format, and size.

input.description: Path to the media file to probe.

name: trim
title: Trim Video
description: Cut a video down to one sub-clip by start + (end or duration). For several segments use clip; to combine with other edits use pipeline.

end.description: End time in seconds. Use end OR duration.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Use end OR duration.

exact.description: Re-encode for a frame-exact cut with the removed content really gone (default true). false = fast stream copy that snaps to a keyframe and keeps hidden earlier frames; never use it to remove secrets.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: concat
title: Concatenate Videos
description: Join videos end to end with hard cuts: stream copy when they match, else a re-encode (`mode` says which). For transitions use xfade_transition or assemble_highlights.

inputs.description: Video paths to join, in order.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: convert
title: Convert Format
description: Convert media to mp4, webm, or gif. For a size-bounded GIF/WebP prefer export_gif; for a smaller mp4, compress or export_preset.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: export_gif
title: Export GIF or WebP
description: Export an animated GIF or WebP that fits a size budget (for PRs, issues, READMEs), stepping fps, width, and quality down until it fits.

maxBytes.description: Size budget in bytes (default 10000000, under GitHub's 10 MB image limit).

duration.description: Seconds to export (default: to the end).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: crop
title: Crop Video
description: Crop a video to a pixel rectangle; one running off the frame is rejected.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: scale
title: Scale Video
description: Resize a video to a target width and/or height and re-encode. Provide one side to keep the aspect ratio, or both to set an exact size.

width.description: Target width in px. Omit to derive from height (keeps aspect).

height.description: Target height in px. Omit to derive from width (keeps aspect).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: speed
title: Change Speed
description: Change playback speed by a factor (>1 faster, <1 slower) and re-encode. Audio is retempo'd to match when the source has an audio track.

factor.description: Speed multiplier: >1 is faster, <1 is slower (e.g. 2 = double speed).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: overlay
title: Overlay Image or Video
description: Composite an image or video (logo, watermark, picture-in-picture) onto a video at a pixel position, optionally scaled and time-limited; keeps the base's audio and length.

width.description: Scale to this width (other side keeps aspect).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: callout
title: Add Callouts
description: Annotate a video with timed boxes, text labels, and arrows. Fallback fonts used are listed in fallbackFonts; characters no font covers are reported in warnings.

background.description: Dark panel behind the text (default true).

x2.description: Head (x2,y2) is the point the arrow points at.

items.description: Boxes, text labels, and arrows, drawn in order (later on top), in video pixels. Each shows from..to seconds (default: whole video); color is a name, #RRGGBB, or name@alpha.

fontFile.description: Font: a .ttf/.otf/.ttc path or a C:\Windows\Fonts file name. Default: bundled Inter, with a covering system font for scripts it lacks (CJK, emoji, Arabic, ...).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: keystroke_overlay
title: Keystroke Overlay
description: Burn keycast-style badges for shortcuts, clicks, and typing from the recording's input event log (start_recording events: true). Never shows typed text: the log has none.

keys.description: shortcuts (default): the chord (Ctrl + S); masked: modifiers only (Ctrl + …).

size.description: Font px (default 4.5% of the frame height).

fontFile.description: Font: a .ttf/.otf/.ttc path or a C:\Windows\Fonts file name. Default: bundled Inter, with a covering system font for scripts it lacks (CJK, emoji, Arabic, ...).

dryRun.description: Return the planned badges; write nothing.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: cursor
title: Re-rendered Cursor
description: Draw a smoothed, scaled cursor that hides when idle from the event log of a start_recording cursor: "events" recording (no OS cursor in the video), with click ripples and an optional spotlight.

hideAfterSec.description: Hide when the mouse rests this long; 0 = never (default 2).

spotlight.description: Dim all but the area around the cursor.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: backdrop
title: Add Backdrop
description: Frame a video or screenshot on a gradient, color, or wallpaper with padding, rounded corners, and a drop shadow, optionally on a 16:9/1:1/9:16/4:5 canvas.

input.description: Path to the source video or image (png/jpg).

preset.description: Gradient: desktop (default, dark slate), rec (red), amber, light.

image.description: Instead: a wallpaper image, scaled to cover.

padding.description: px around the content (default 6% of the longer side).

radius.description: Corner radius px (default ~1.2% of the longer side; 0 = square).

aspect.description: Output on this aspect's canvas (1920x1080, ...), content scaled to fit.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits (screenshots for an image).

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: compress
title: Compress Video
description: Re-encode a video smaller (H.264 CRF ladder, optional width cap). For a platform target use export_preset.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: extract_audio
title: Extract Audio
description: Extract the audio track of a media file to its own file (mp3, aac, wav, or copy). Returns the output path.

format.description: Audio output codec. copy keeps the source codec without re-encoding.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: normalize_audio
title: Normalize Loudness
description: Normalize loudness to a delivery target (two-pass EBU R128 loudnorm); video is copied. Reports loudness before and after.

input.description: Path to the source video or audio file.

target.description: youtube (-14 LUFS, default), podcast (-16), broadcast (-23), or a LUFS number.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: denoise
title: Denoise Audio
description: Reduce steady background noise (fan, hum, hiss) in a recording's audio with an adaptive FFT denoiser. Video is copied untouched. Returns the output path.

input.description: Path to the source video or audio file.

strength.description: How hard to reduce noise: light (6 dB), medium (12 dB, default), strong (20 dB).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: transcribe
title: Transcribe Speech
description: Transcribe a recording's speech to an SRT subtitle file, locally, with FFmpeg 8's whisper filter (needs a whisper.cpp model file). Returns the SRT path and the text. Pair with burn_subtitles to caption the video.

input.description: Path to the video or audio to transcribe.

model.description: Path to a whisper.cpp model file (ggml-*.bin). Defaults to SCREENCAST_WHISPER_MODEL.

words.description: One word per cue, for word timing (cut_by_transcript).

output.description: Optional output .srt path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: burn_subtitles
title: Burn In Subtitles
description: Burn SRT/ASS subtitles (e.g. from transcribe) into a video in the bundled font.

subtitles.description: Path to an .srt (e.g. from transcribe) or .ass subtitle file.

style.description: clean (default for .srt): outlined line. social: big bold text on a dark box. .ass keeps its own styling unless set.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: chapters
title: Chapters
description: Write chapters (markers, scene changes, transcript, or a list) into an mp4/mkv/mov copy without re-encoding; returns YouTube chapter text. Can mux an SRT as soft subtitles.

from.description: markers (default; add_marker, else the file's chapters), scenes (screen changes), or transcript (SRT sections).

subtitles.description: Also mux this .srt/.vtt/.ass as a soft subtitle track.

textOnly.description: Return chapters and YouTube text only; write no file.

output.description: Optional .mp4/.mkv/.mov path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output file.

name: clip
title: Extract Clips
description: Extract several frame-exact segments, each to its own file. For one segment, trim does the same.

segments.description: {start, end} segments in seconds; each becomes its own file.

output.description: Optional output path. Only honored for a single segment; multi-segment output lands under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: cut_idle
title: Cut Idle Stretches
description: Remove dead air: cut stretches where the screen is frozen (and silent), keeping a short pad. Returns the time saved.

minIdleSec.description: Only cut still stretches at least this long (default 2).

keepSec.description: Seconds kept at each edge of a cut (default 0.4).

useAudio.description: Require silent audio too (default true when there is audio).

dryRun.description: Only report what would be cut.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: cut_by_transcript
title: Cut By Transcript
description: Edit a video by its transcript: cut quoted text, cue numbers, or fillers. Also writes the re-timed .srt.

srt.description: Its .srt (transcribe; words: true for word timing).

remove.description: Cue numbers, or transcript text quoted exactly (must occur once).

fillers.description: Also cut fillers (um, uh...) that have their own cue.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: redact_region
title: Redact Regions
description: Cover given rectangles in a video (e.g. secrets on screen). Not automatic detection: find them with find_text redact: true. Off-frame regions are rejected.

regions.description: Pixel rectangles (x, y, width, height), each optionally limited to start..end seconds.

style.description: box (default): irreversible fill; blur/pixelate are partially recoverable.

pad.description: Grow each region by this many px (default 0).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: list_audio_devices
title: List Audio Devices
description: List DirectShow audio devices and flag a likely loopback (Stereo Mix or a virtual-audio driver), for start_recording's audio.device.

name: list_video_devices
title: List Video Devices
description: List DirectShow cameras for start_recording's webcam.device.

name: list_targets
title: List Capture Targets
description: List the desktop, monitors, and visible windows (topmost first, with capturability per backend). Each entry has a `target` string to pass as-is to capture tools; use it instead of guessing a title.

exe.description: Only list windows of this executable, e.g. 'Code.exe' or 'code'.

titleContains.description: Only list windows whose title contains this text (case-insensitive).

capturableOnly.description: Leave out windows neither backend can capture (minimized, off screen). Default false.

name: doctor
title: Check Setup
description: Check the setup: ffmpeg/ffprobe (FFmpeg 8+?), optional filters, capture devices, Windows OCR, settings, and enabled toolsets; `problems` says what is missing and how to fix it. Call on first use or when a tool reports a missing feature.

name: xfade_transition
title: Crossfade Transition
description: Join two videos with an xfade transition (audio crossfaded); they need not match in size, fps, or audio. For more clips use assemble_highlights.

transition.description: xfade name (default fade): fade, wipeleft, slideup, circleopen, dissolve, ...

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: assemble_highlights
title: Assemble Highlights
description: Stitch clips (including title cards) into one video with cuts or xfade transitions; they need not match in size, fps, or audio.

transition.description: cut (default) or an xfade name (fade, wipeleft, slideup, ...).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: title_card
title: Title Card
description: Generate a title card clip (centered text on a solid background, silent audio track) to stitch in with assemble_highlights. Uncoverable characters are reported in warnings.

text.description: Title text. Multiple lines are allowed (use \n).

fontFile.description: Font: a .ttf/.otf/.ttc path or a C:\Windows\Fonts file name. Default: bundled Inter, with a covering system font for scripts it lacks (CJK, emoji, Arabic, ...).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: music_bed
title: Add Music Bed
description: Lay music under a video: looped or trimmed to length, faded, leveled, and mixed with any existing audio. Video is stream-copied.

duck.description: Duck the music under the original audio (default false).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: narrate
title: Narrate
description: Offline voiceover with the built-in Windows voices: speaks each line at its time or marker over the audio, plus an SRT.

voice.description: Voice name or part (doctor lists them).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: reframe
title: Reframe Aspect Ratio
description: Re-aspect a video to 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, or 4:5 by padding or cropping.

fit.description: pad (default): letterbox, nothing lost. crop: fill and center-crop.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: zoom
title: Zoom and Pan
description: Smooth animated zoom-and-pan into the action and back out, from keyframes or planned from logged clicks or screen changes.

keyframes.description: Views reached by time t: a source rectangle (x, y, width, height), or { t, full: true } to zoom out. Omit to plan them (see follow).

follow.description: Without keyframes: clicks (from the events log of start_recording events: true) or changes (where the screen changed). auto (default): clicks if logged, else changes.

events.description: Events log (default: the input's .events.jsonl); must match the input's timing and size, so use the original recording.

maxZoom.description: Auto mode: the furthest it zooms in (default 2.5).

holdSec.description: Auto mode: stay zoomed this long after activity (default 2).

dryRun.description: Return the planned keyframes only (editable, pass back).

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: pipeline
title: Edit Pipeline
description: Run several edits (trim, crop, scale, speed, cut_idle, redact, callout, keystroke_overlay, cursor, reframe, zoom, backdrop, audio, burn_subtitles, then optionally export_preset or export_gif) in one ffmpeg pass: one re-encode, no intermediate files. Prefer it over chaining edit tools; a recipe does the usual polish in one call.

steps.description: Edits in order, each { op, ...its tool's options }; export_preset/export_gif only last. Times and pixels are relative to the video as it is at that step (after earlier trims, speed, crops). zoom follow:"clicks" plans from the event log; burn_subtitles takes subtitles or transcribe:true.

background.description: Dark panel behind the text (default true).

x2.description: Head (x2,y2) is the point the arrow points at.

fontFile.description: Font: a .ttf/.otf/.ttc path or a C:\Windows\Fonts file name. Default: bundled Inter, with a covering system font for scripts it lacks (CJK, emoji, Arabic, ...).

recipe.description: Polish preset expanded to steps (see dryRun): pr_demo = cut_idle, click zoom, GIF <=10 MB; tutorial = + audio, captions, 1080p mp4; social_reel = 9:16, big captions. Given steps replace its same-op step.

quality.description: Encoder preset for an mp4 result (default standard).

dryRun.description: Return the plan (ffmpeg command, output size) without running it.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

chapters.description: Keep the input's markers as chapters, re-timed through trims and speed.

name: export_preset
title: Export for Platform
description: Encode a platform-ready H.264 file (aspect, fps, bitrate, faststart) for a named platform.

platform.description: Sets aspect, size, fps, bitrate. steam_trailer: 1080p 5.5 Mbps CBR, -14 LUFS. vertical_reel: 1080x1920 over a blurred copy of itself, -14 LUFS (ignores fit).

fit.description: Fit to the platform aspect: pad (default) or crop.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: bug_report
title: Bug Report Package
description: Package a recording as a paste-ready repro folder: secret-scanned, redacted clip and GIF, contact sheet, steps from the event log, OCR'd errors, environment, report.md for gh issue create --body-file.

redact.description: Box out OCR-found secrets in every output (default true; needs Windows OCR).

secretPattern.description: Secret regex (default: API keys, tokens, password: values).

regions.description: Extra boxes (video px; start/end on the clip clock).

outputDir.description: Package folder (default: a new one in SCREENCAST_HOME/edits).

overwrite.description: Replace a report already in outputDir.

name: step_guide
title: Step-by-Step Guide
description: Turn a recording's event log into a numbered how-to: a ringed screenshot and caption per step, marker headings; Markdown and/or one HTML file. Never includes typed text.

format.description: md + images/, self-contained html, or both (default).

ocr.description: OCR shots for captions and secret boxes (default true; needs Windows OCR).

overwrite.description: Replace a guide already in outputDir.
